title: Pause PsychoJS microphones before finishing their component state
problem: Generated PsychoJS marks a microphone FINISHED before calling pause(). PsychoJS only pauses a recorder whose status is STARTED, so the MediaRecorder remains active and the next loop iteration raises InvalidStateError when start() is called again.
reproduce: Execute the pinned production BaseComponent and MicrophoneComponent JavaScript generator methods for a two-second recording. In the baseline output, the FINISHED assignment precedes mic.pause().
acceptance: The generated stop block calls mic.pause() while its status is still STARTED, then performs exactly one transition to PsychoJS.Status.FINISHED. The complete PsychoPy component compiler test also passes.
repair: Allow components to defer the common generated FINISHED transition; use that option for MicrophoneComponent and emit the transition immediately after pause(). Add a generator regression test for the required order.

verification.limitations: BCL executes the production generator methods and proves the baseline-to-candidate statement order. The local upstream compiler tests pass. A browser MediaRecorder and real microphone loop remain reporter-operated checks.
verification.ownerCheck: Open the reporter's two-iteration Pavlovia reproduction with microphone permission granted. Complete both recording iterations and confirm the second starts without InvalidStateError and both clips are available.

publish.commitMessage: BF: pause online microphones before finishing

upstream.suiteOutputIncludes: PASS: generated PsychoJS pauses the active microphone before marking it FINISHED
